outcome.implementation_change: ECI now includes integrity-verified unmeasurable verification-obligation candidates in its bounded root candidate count. It adds reason/repository counts, exact source-record accounting and provenance, and explicit candidate-window, defect, recurrence, and burden limits. The information is preserved through response compaction without duplicating source pairs already present in exact provider-context links.
outcome.verified_change: The focused capability-intelligence suite passed 194 tests after the change. The cross-process vertical proof passed. A read-only comparison on the same selected session changed the root candidate occurrence count from 0 to 8 and exposed the bounded reason/repository distribution while retaining exact Store source relationships.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The projection demonstrates that existing verified candidates are now countable and inspectable at the root. It does not establish a provider defect, complete candidate coverage, service correctness, agent receipt, or reduced intervention.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Verified ambient verification candidates are absent from the ECI root candidate summary
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ECI session activity candidate projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The read-only baseline projection had a zero root candidate count while the nested readiness relation contained eight integrity-verified candidates. The implementation exposes those bounded occurrences and exact provenance without claiming that the provider or its service is defective.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use the repository/reason groups and exact Store references to inspect which verification executor obligations lack native provider context, and observe future sessions before assessing recurrence or agent burden.
not_measured: agent receipt or use of the new projection fields
verification service correctness or need fulfillment

improvement_relation.basis: The regression suite covers repository/reason grouping, exact source linkage, root candidate aggregation, and compact projection preservation. The paired readback of the same authentic session confirms the root now includes the previously nested integrity-verified candidates and keeps their limits explicit.
not_measured: whether the projection changed subsequent agent behavior

measurement_limits: The before/after projection records are read-only observations of one selected session.
Candidate extraction reached its limit and provider readiness context returned two of eight candidates.
No cross-session recurrence, service outcome quality, agent receipt, or intervention reduction is established.
The full repository suite was run before the change; post-change verification includes 194 focused tests and the vertical proof.
